title: Addition Fact Strategies Within 20
description: Practice counting on, making 10, using doubles and near doubles, and choosing an efficient strategy to add within 20.
learningFocus: Use counting on, making 10, doubles, and near doubles to solve addition facts within 20 and select a helpful strategy for each problem.
adultGuidance: Invite your child to explain why a strategy fits each problem, and praise a different valid strategy when it produces the correct sum. Finger counting is welcome while children learn to count on, and the separate answer key is for adult support.
